$comment: Gates are guarded so they pass on the empty baseline; once U1 lands, 'make check' (lint + typecheck + backend pytest in a throwaway Postgres container + frontend vitest) is enforced for every unit.
install: if [ -f frontend/package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --prefix frontend --no-audit --no-fund; fi

sharedCache.note: npm uses the shared ~/.npm cache; backend deps live in the Docker image layer cache.

unit.cmd: if [ -f Makefile ]; then make check; else echo 'no Makefile yet (empty baseline)'; fi

integration.cmd: if [ -f Makefile ]; then make check; else echo 'no Makefile yet (empty baseline)'; fi
